result.summary: The page is mostly polished, but there are two visible issues: a bottom restaurant card is clipped by the fixed navigation bar, and a restaurant name in the horizontal list is truncated.

issues.description: The last 'Popular right now' card (pizza) is cut off at the bottom by the fixed tab navigation bar, so its details and tappable area are partially hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or a scroll inset equal to the navigation bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view above the nav bar.

issues.description: The third card under 'Fastest near you' shows a truncated restaurant name ('Trattoria Picco...'), making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Show the full name on tap, expand card width if possible, or allow the text to wrap to a second line with truncation/ellipsis handling.
